language.description: Language used in answer and steps

answer.description: Max 2 short sentences in the guest's language

steps.description: Max 4 ordered actions; empty if none

ask_if_solved.description: true when steps were given to fix a problem, so the app asks 'Did it work?'

grounded.description: true only if every fact came from the manual

escalate.description: true when the owner must be notified

owner_summary_ko.description: One Korean line for the owner when escalate is true, otherwise empty
